method: Separate read-only reconstruction from immutable Git, finite upstream decisions, frozen category presets and positional pronunciation records. This is structural auditing, not a new linguistic editor.

independent_linguistic_review.scope: Single AI author read all selected displays and main keys and provided contextual decisions. No second human/AI editorial review is claimed. Native input quality is measured separately.

batches.editorial_review_scope: Single AI author editorial review of every selected display/key; explicit contextual decisions for all detected polyphones. Structural checks are separate and are not described as an independent human review.
